label: INCLUSIVE_PAST_ACCESSIBILITY_2: For a supplied Preorder T, accessibility from t to s means s≤t…
definition: For a supplied Preorder T, accessibility from t to s means s≤t, including the current time. This inline instance of the existing Frame is reflexive and serial regardless of whether an earliest time exists. Inclusive self-access does not supply a strictly earlier time.
note: Owner-approved bounded temporal interpretation of the existing Frame/order vocabulary; no new Lean semantic primitive. See inline frames in Modal.PastSerialityCertificate. Time points are not identified with modal alternative complete histories or causal graph vertices. No physical-past, duration or event-count claim.
